# Vendored h5p-standalone

- Package: `h5p-standalone`
- Version: `3.8.2`
- Source: npm package `h5p-standalone@3.8.2`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

The full `dist` directory is retained because `styles/h5p.css` references
font and image assets using relative paths. This version includes the newer
H5P theme variables and `fonts/h5p-theme.woff2`.
